nodes.name: ReadSpotifyHistory
nodes.role: read the user's transaction history and find the past payments made to Spotify

nodes.name: DeriveUsualAmount
nodes.role: work out the amount the user usually pays Spotify from those past payments

nodes.name: BuildStandingOrder
nodes.role: assemble a recurring scheduled transaction using the usual amount and the recipient the user names

nodes.name: ScheduleStandingOrder
nodes.role: create the approved recurring scheduled transaction with the bank and report its confirmation
